ld.description: Mild by Nature Nature’s Gate Biotin & Bamboo Shampoo Formulated Specifically for Thin, Damaged Hair Featuring Biotin, Bamboo, and Pro-Vitamin B5 With Clean, Natural Ingredients – No Artificial Colors Vegan and Cruelty Free No Nasties – Paraben Free • Gluten Free • Soy Free • Phthalate Free Formulated to be Good for People and the Planet We’re excited to share that Nature’s Gate is now a part of the Mild by Nature family of products. You can still expect the same eco-conscious and nature-inspired formulas, just with a new brand and a new family of effective personal care products. Heal your dry, damaged, and thin hair with Nature’s Gate Biotin & Bamboo Shampoo . Formulated with a unique blend of biotin, bamboo, and pro-vitamin B5, this shampoo gently cleanses hair while also helping to nourish and strengthen. Nature’s Gate Biotin & Bamboo Shampoo is a healthy way to help to add volume to thinning hair with clean, natural ingredients. This product is cruelty free and contains no parabens, phthalates, or artificial colors.
